features.notes: F009a complete. F009b Stage 1 complete (safe memory injection). F009b Stage 2: recovery-action extraction corrected; memory-on/off behavioral comparisons are CONFOUNDED: traces/ollama_repro_audit_v1 shows byte-identical first-turn requests to qwen3:8b on Ollama 0.40.2 yield different first actions depending on preceding-request history (observe cold vs pick after another prompt; mechanism unverified). All pilot/ablation results under traces/ are marked confounded (traces/CONFOUNDED_COMPARISONS.md). 30-pair evaluation NOT run and blocked until each LLM call can be made from a controlled, recorded server history. Known limitations: only the first success after a failure is recorded (observe can occupy the slot); AgentLoop re-saves the index on every memory-on run; 'N days ago' makes memory prompts time-dependent. Proposed next feature: observation-grounding contract (reject physical skills not grounded in a fresh tool observation). BACKLOG: parser/loop inconsistency - an env SkillOutcome(ok=False, failure=None) is a success to the loop (verify returns None) but a failure to the memory parser, which can create a spurious pending failure and recovery label; not fixed (no runtime change). BACKLOG: regenerate traces/.memory_index_frozen.json at INDEX_VERSION 2 before any further evaluation.
